This system uses GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for instant crypto verification. The customer owns the entire stack, ensuring no platform can shut them down. This isn’t a temporary fix; it’s a permanent solution built to withstand financial isolation and currency instability. For creators who value ownership and control, this is the infrastructure they’ve been waiting for.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This architecture is a complete digital commerce stack designed for creators who cannot use traditional payment processors. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. The core components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. NOWPayments handles crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer account required. The system is automated: once payment is verified on-chain, the ebook is delivered instantly. This setup eliminates dependency on platforms like Stripe or PayPal, giving creators full data ownership and control over their infrastructure. It’s not just a store—it’s a sovereign commerce system built to last.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The process begins when a customer purchases an ebook using cryptocurrency via NOWPayments. The payment is verified on-chain, and a webhook triggers the backend logic hosted on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This logic checks the payment status and, upon confirmation, generates a secure download link for the ebook stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The link is then sent to the customer’s email or displayed on a confirmation page. All order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets for future reference. The entire process is automated, requiring no manual intervention from the creator. This system is designed for scalability, handling multiple transactions simultaneously without performance degradation. It’s a lean, efficient architecture that prioritizes speed, security, and sovereignty.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators in regions like Kenya, Nigeria, and Zimbabwe, where traditional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. These creators sell ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products but lack the tools to collect payments and deliver products securely. The system is also ideal for creators who value ownership and control over their infrastructure. By using this stack, they avoid the risk of platform shutdowns, payment rejections, or data breaches. It’s particularly suited for creators who operate in volatile economic environments, where currency collapse or financial isolation is a real threat. This architecture isn’t just a tool—it’s a statement of independence, designed for those who refuse to be locked out of the global digital economy.
This architecture gives you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure—no platform dependencies.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack relies on carefully selected components that work seamlessly together. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting for the storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, ensuring automated delivery and payment verification. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host the digital products for delivery. NOWPayments integrates crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, supporting over 300 cryptocurrencies and requiring no buyer KYC. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of integration. Together, they form a robust system that gives creators full control over their commerce infrastructure. There are no subscriptions, no hidden fees, and no platform dependencies—just a stack the creator owns outright.

Purchase the Complete Builder Kit for $197 to access all blueprints and templates. Follow the step-by-step documentation to set up hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. Load your products into the system and test the end-to-end flow to ensure everything works seamlessly. Once deployed, you’ll have a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. The Complete Builder Kit includes everything you need to get started, from source code to scaling playbooks. This isn’t a theoretical solution—it’s a proven system designed to work in the toughest environments. Deploy today and take control of your digital commerce infrastructure.

The architecture automates ebook delivery after crypto payment by integrating NOWPayments for instant transaction verification, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file hosting. Once payment is confirmed on-chain, a webhook triggers the delivery process, generating a secure download link for the customer. This system eliminates manual intervention, ensures instant delivery, and provides full data ownership to the creator. It’s designed to work reliably even in regions with restricted access to traditional payment processors.
Automated delivery ensures your customers receive their ebooks instantly after payment confirmation.

Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose the stack that fits your needs: Sovereign Starter Stack or Edge Commerce Stack. 2. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit for $197 to access all blueprints and templates. 3. Set up hosting using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Configure backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Upload your ebooks or digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Test the end-to-end flow to ensure seamless payment verification and product delivery. 8. Deploy your stack and start selling with full ownership and control.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?
Yes, the Complete Builder Kit includes detailed documentation and templates designed for non-technical creators. Follow the step-by-step guides to deploy your stack without coding expertise.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees?
No, there are no subscriptions or recurring fees. You own the infrastructure outright after deployment. The only cost is the 0.5% fee per transaction via NOWPayments.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes, the architecture is designed for scalability. The Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook to help you handle increased traffic and transactions.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
The system is designed to be resilient. If NOWPayments experiences issues, you can switch to another crypto payment provider or use the backup logic included in the blueprints.
